'''Insects control''' is a weave in the [[One Power]]; it is used to attract or repel and generally to manipulate the behaviour of the insects. Moiraine used it against Lan sending to him hordes of ants; Moiraine also affirmed that this was one of the secret weaves of the [[Blue Ajah]]. But also Cadsuane know it very well and used it to repel swarms of flies from inside a barn.
